versions.changelog:
- Initial release of huo15-detective for enterprise/personnel background checks.
- Provides detailed investigation workflow, platform recommendations, risk identification, and report generation.
- Includes step-by-step guidance on using Qichacha and other platforms for company and individual checks.
- Outlines risk assessment criteria, practical verification methods, and reporting standards.
- Requires integration with huo15-doc-template (for report generation) and web-search-plus (for data lookup).
